strategy.summary: Reproduce the numerical/special-value bug in apache/commons-math PR #326 at buggy commit 4e14c08c57d93b535aba874dd02642a680ab7ec6. CompositeFormat.parseNumber uses a check `endIndex < source.length()` before matching a special value token (NaN, Infinity, -Infinity), so when the special token reaches the final character of the input — e.g. the real-only string "(NaN)" or "(Infinity)" — it is not recognized and parsing fails with MathParseException. The new tests in ComplexFormatAbstractTest (testParseRealNan, testParseRealInfinity, testParseImaginarySpecialValue) assert that these round trips and direct parses succeed. At the buggy commit these tests should FAIL because parse throws for trailing real-only special values.

input_output_examples.buggy_output: MathParseException: the trailing NaN special-value token is not recognized (CompositeFormat.parseNumber checks endIndex < source.length(), so it rejects tokens ending at the final character)
MathParseException: format/parse round trip fails because the returned string's trailing NaN is not recognized
MathParseException: the trailing Infinity special-value token is not recognized
MathParseException: the trailing -Infinity special-value token is not recognized
MathParseException on round-trip parsing for real-only positive/negative infinity

environment_setup: Clone apache/commons-math at buggy commit 4e14c08c57d93b535aba874dd02642a680ab7ec6 (the checked-out revision); do not apply the fix.
Ensure JDK 8+ and Apache Maven 3.8+ are installed; the project is a standard multi-module Maven Java build.
Confirm repository layout contains commons-math-legacy module with the modified test file commons-math-legacy/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/math4/legacy/util/ComplexFormatAbstractTest.java.
build_steps: From the repository root, run `mvn -pl commons-math-legacy -am clean test -DskipTests=false` or, following CI evidence, `mvn clean verify javadoc:javadoc` if a full build is required.
Run the module test build first, if desired: `mvn -pl commons-math-legacy -am test-compile` to confirm the test class compiles at this revision.
reproduction_steps: Run the new reproducing test class with the specific selectors: `mvn -pl commons-math-legacy -am test -Dtest=ComplexFormatAbstractTest#testParseRealNan+testParseRealInfinity+testParseImaginarySpecialValue` from the repository root.

Observe that with the buggy commit, testParseRealNan and testParseRealInfinity fail with MathParseException from `complexFormat.parse("(NaN)")`, `complexFormat.parse("(Infinity)")`, `complexFormat.parse("(-Infinity)")`, and the corresponding round-trip parses.
Note the exact failure location/assertion: Assert.assertEquals(expected, complexFormat.parse("(NaN)")) and related assertions in the newly added tests.

For optional confirmation, run `mvn -pl commons-math-legacy -am test -Dtest=ComplexFormatAbstractTest#testParseImaginarySpecialValue` separately — it should pass at the buggy commit because the imaginary special value is not at the final character.
strategy.expected_buggy_behavior: At the buggy commit, CompositeFormat.parseNumber checks `endIndex < source.length()` before matching special values, so strings whose NaN/Infinity token ends at the last character are rejected. Consequently ComplexFormat.parse("(NaN)"), parse("(Infinity)"), parse("(-Infinity)"), and format/parse round trips for real-only NaN or +/-Infinity throw MathParseException, causing the newly added testParseRealNan and testParseRealInfinity JUnit tests to FAIL.
strategy.expected_fixed_behavior: After the fix (PR #326 changes the check to `endIndex <= source.length()`), the trailing special-value token is recognized: ComplexFormat.parse("(NaN)") returns Complex.ofCartesian(Double.NaN, 0), parse("(Infinity)") returns Complex.ofCartesian(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, 0), parse("(-Infinity)") returns Complex.ofCartesian(Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY, 0), and the format/parse round trips for real-only special values succeed. All three new tests pass.
strategy.success_criterion: The reproducing command fails on the buggy commit — specifically testParseRealNan and testParseRealInfinity fail with MathParseException because the trailing real-only special-value token is not recognized — and the same command succeeds once the fix is applied at commit 8a940bfc5dc1a83baf3fadcb4668acbf6591a85c.
risks_or_ambiguities: The PR/issue discussion does not specify an exact Maven version or JDK version; the build command `mvn clean verify javadoc:javadoc` is from the PR's modified workflow files and may require different flags at this old revision.

ComplexFormatAbstractTest is an abstract/superclass test; running only this class with Maven's `-Dtest` may pick its concrete subclass(es) or may find no runnable tests depending on the Surefire version. If no tests run, use `-Dtest=ComplexFormatAbstractTest -DfailIfNoTests=false` or run the concrete subclass that extends it.

The new tests are introduced in the PR diff; at the buggy commit the test file may lack them unless the agent applies the PR's test-file changes. Reproduction requires checking out the test diff from the PR or temporarily adding the three test methods.

testParseImaginarySpecialValue should succeed even at the buggy commit, so the targeted reproduction should focus on the two real-only tests that fail.
